correctness.rationale: The bundled verifier reconstructs the canonical 30-vertex graph, enumerates all 476,186 nonempty independent faces, verifies the stated face vector, creates 238,088 valid Hasse-edge matching pairs, and directly topologically sorts the full Morse-oriented Hasse graph on 3,461,400 covers. The only critical cells are one 0-cell and nine 8-cells, which gives the claimed wedge by Forman discrete Morse theory.

value.rationale: The Tutte–Coxeter graph is a canonical highly symmetric cubic girth-eight incidence graph that already plays a distinguished role in independent-set extremal literature. An exact homotopy type for its independence complex supplies a natural benchmark beyond the grid and small generalized-Petersen examples, and the clean nine-sphere model exposes integral homology and simple-homotopy information not recoverable from independent-set counts alone.
